text: Clinicians can estimate kidney filtration from a blood test that measures creatinine. The estimate is called eGFR. A clinician interprets the result in the context of other findings.

title: Chronic Kidney Disease Tests & Diagnosis

text: A urine albumin-to-creatinine ratio measures albumin relative to creatinine in urine. A clinician may repeat urine testing to confirm a finding.

title: Estimated Glomerular Filtration Rate (eGFR)
section: About estimated glomerular rate (eGFR); Types of GFR Tests
usage: Original educational paraphrase with attribution. Publisher text and PDFs are excluded.
text: Estimated glomerular filtration rate describes how well the kidneys filter blood. Creatinine and sometimes cystatin C inform the estimate. Discuss interpretation of your results with your healthcare team.

title: KDIGO 2024 Clinical Practice Guideline for the Evaluation and Management of CKD
usage: Original educational paraphrase with attribution. Publisher text and PDFs are excluded.
text: Evaluating possible chronic kidney disease includes considering kidney filtration, markers such as albumin in urine, and whether abnormalities persist over time. A single measurement does not establish chronicity.
